note: Intent presets written from public facts. Each row is a woof_plan intent; values the user gives win over the preset's. Adding a preset is a JSON edit.

presets.title: Quick 3 km look
presets.description: A 300 km box at 3 km from the latest HRRR, 3 hours. The fastest useful storm-scale run; about 4 minutes on an RTX 4090 the first time, about 1 minute once the data and kernels are warm.

presets.title: Southern Plains 12 km
presets.description: Regional 12 km run over Oklahoma and Texas from the latest GFS, 3 hours. Works anywhere GFS does if you give another point.

presets.title: CONUS 3 km
presets.description: The whole lower 48 at 3 km from the latest GFS, 6 hours (796 x 636 columns). Needs a 24 GB or larger card.

presets.title: San Francisco Bay 750 m
presets.description: Coastal fog and sea breeze: 2.25 km outer grid with a 750 m nest over the Bay Area, HRRR pressure levels, 36 hours, 59 levels, Thompson, MYNN and RUC.

presets.title: Los Angeles basin 750 m
presets.description: Same shape as the Bay Area preset, centred on the Los Angeles basin.

presets.title: New York City 500 m
presets.description: 1 km outer grid with a 500 m nest over New York City and the harbour, HRRR, 12 hours.

presets.title: Toronto 500 m
presets.description: Same shape as the New York preset, centred on Toronto and Lake Ontario.
